VBO:0201283.summary: Eager on the trail and fond of travel, Chloe was a Springer–Corgi Sporgi. She led hikes alongside other dogs and celebrated her seventeenth birthday on a library tour. Close companionship with her owner’s family ran through her long life, including staying beside them through their final days.
